notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 released: minor fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]added version number indicator to main menu
[*]fixed multiple issues related to various controllers initializing with the wrong button mappings
[*]fixed errors related to loading save games
[*]fixed errors relating to Mokos dying when in certain states
[/list]

Please restart Steam to ensure patch downloads.

notes.title: Pulse is now available!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for playing Pulse!!! We hope you enjoy the game.

Here's the launch trailer, for your viewing pleasure: [url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_cZPF1nZCXQ[/url]

It's been a long journey, from the prototype and Kickstarter 3 years ago, through multiple awards, incorporation, working on the game on our off time, getting Greenlit, and now finally [b]release[/b]!

If you have any questions or comments you can send them to
[b]info@pixelpigames.com[/b]

If you have issues or run into bugs please send them to
[b]support@pixelpigames.com[/b]

We will also keep an eye on the Steam forums so posting there works too!

Thank you so much!
The Team at Pixel Pi Games <3
[url]http://www.pixelpigames.com[/url]
